corrections.round1Hypothesis: R1: match='.html', template='page{N}.html' (sort NOT baked in). DB: match='.html?sort=newest', template='page{N}.html?sort=newest'.
corrections.liveMethod: Traced buildPaginatedUrl suffix-replace branch (catalog-crawler.ts:128-137) against the real catalogUrl base 'https://www.fulcrumoutdoors.ca/firearms/?sort=newest', then live-fetched both the mangled and correct URLs.
corrections.evidence: buildPaginatedUrl receives stream.url = '.../firearms/?sort=newest' (catalog-crawler.ts:781). suffix-replace does baseUrl.endsWith(match). R1 match='.html' -> endsWith FALSE -> fallback L132-133 appends -> '.../firearms/?sort=newestpage2.html' (MANGLED). DB match='.html?sort=newest' -> endsWith FALSE (base ends '?sort=newest' not '.html?sort=newest') -> fallback -> '.../firearms/?sort=newestpage2.html?sort=newest' (MANGLED). Live: the MANGLED-R1 URL returns 200 but is category DEFAULT page-1 (first slug brigade-mfg-makasi-mk-15 = default-sort head, NOT newest head weatherby-307) -- Lightspeed treats the malformed query as garbage and serves page1/default-sort. SILENT page-1 loop, not a 404. The site's OWN emitted next-page href is 'https://www.fulcrumoutdoors.ca/firearms/page2.html?sort=newest'. The config that reproduces it via buildPaginatedUrl is match='/?sort=newest', template='/page{N}.html?sort=newest' -> live-verified -> 200, first slug ruger-american-gen-2-6mm-creedmoor (genuinely different page). limit+page combine: page1(limit=100) vs page2(limit=100) = 0/100 overlap.

Default render = 12 products/page (page1 slug count = 12). limit=36 -> 36 unique; limit=100 -> 100 unique; limit=250 -> silently reverts to 12. Max honored perPage cap = 100. BOTH numbers are correct on different axes: 12 = native render-per-page used by paginationPattern.perPage (page-walk math); 100 = max limit= cap used by an efficient catalog-walk. Recommend paginationPattern.perPage=12 (matches the page{N} form which renders 12/page when no limit appended) AND record perPageCap=100 so the catalog walk can append &limit=100 for 8x fewer requests (4 pages vs 28 for firearms).

proposedValue.note: 12=render default for pageN.html walk; 100=max limit cap for efficient walk

codeFindings.detail: buildPaginatedUrl suffix-replace branch does baseUrl.endsWith(match). It is called with stream.url = catalogUrl = '.../firearms/?sort=newest' (L781). NEITHER R1's match='.html' NOR DB's match='.html?sort=newest' is a suffix of '.../firearms/?sort=newest' (the URL ends with '?sort=newest'), so BOTH hit the L132-133 fallback ('baseUrl + template') and produce a mangled URL ('.../firearms/?sort=newestpage2.html[?sort=newest]'). Live, the mangled URL returns 200 but is category DEFAULT page-1 -> the catalog walk silently re-fetches page 1 every iteration (terminated only by the prevPageSignature repeat-page guard at L790), so coverage collapses to the first 12 products of every category. CORRECT config: match='/?sort=newest', template='/page{N}.html?sort=newest' (template carries the leading slash so withoutSuffix + template rebuilds '.../firearms/page2.html?sort=newest'). Live-verified to produce a genuinely distinct page with 0/100 overlap at limit=100. ROOT CAUSE: the suffix-replace primitive assumes the base ends in the matched suffix; when sortParam is appended to a directory-style category URL, the '.html' marker is no longer the tail. The match must be the actual tail of the post-sort URL.

The mangled URL does NOT 404 (would be caught by status!=200). It returns HTTP 200 with page-1/default-sort content. The only thing preventing an infinite loop is prevPageSignature equality detection (L790 comment + repeat-page break). Net effect of a mangled suffix-replace config on Lightspeed = exactly 12 products/category indexed, silently. High-severity coverage bug, not a crash.
